title: UX-01 task 4: the deckbuilder reference
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Implementation-plan task 4 (standard §18, design screen 2): DeckWorkspace (catalog and deck regions on wide layouts with an inspector slot; Catalog and Deck tabs with a persistent summary bar below 64 rem), DeckPanel (header, scrolling body, pinned footer that is a named focusable group), FilterBar (search with result count, ink and cost toggle groups, type, rarity, set, inkability and classification selects, Reset filters, and a filters sheet below the wide layout), ViewSwitch (single-choice toggle group), CatalogResults (card grid by default, dense list, loading placeholders, empty state) and CatalogTileControls (decision D28: Remove, quantity, Add; the card itself opens it), DeckHeader, DeckList (grouped by cost), DeckSummary, CostCurve (one neutral series, labelled caps, no gridlines, a hidden table for assistive technology), ValidationSummary (rules with the policy version, ownership and advice kept apart), SaveState, ImportPreview and ExportDialog. All Experimental with documentation contracts and stories for every documented state.

DeckEntry: the card name is now the inspect button (accessible name 'Inspect <name>' contains the visible name), replacing a 'Printing' button whose accessible name did not contain its visible text (WCAG 2.5.3); the line uses a grid that fits a narrow deck region; the quantity keeps its label for assistive technology. QuantityField gains labelVisibility and a compact size; InkIdentity gains a plain appearance for use inside controls; InspectorHost and FilterBar share the new foundation hook useAtLeast.

Component tokens catalog.tile-min, catalog.search-min, catalog.select-min, deckbuilder.deck (25 rem), deckbuilder.deck-narrow (22.5 rem, widened from the design's 20 rem after the visual review), chart.plot-block-size, chart.bar-max, chart.bar-radius and control.compact-input; the filter and undo icons in the curated registry; 49 component strings.

Reference data and stories: stories/support/reference/cards.ts (reference and presentation fixtures as presentational printings, the printed set from the identifier), deck.ts (the Core demonstration format record, identity-based copy counts, rules, ownership and advice validation, summary figures, text and CSV export), decks.ts (the two 60-card decks, working, invalid and ownership states), catalog.ts (deterministic catalog order, filtering and an import parser that never substitutes). Deckbuilder.stories.tsx composes the room with real add, remove and undo, announcements, a printing preference separate from gameplay identity, a save and conflict flow, and a leave guard through React Aria's RouterProvider; stories cover the design's 11 states plus an empty deck.

Eleven deckbuilder browser tests in reference.spec.ts. RUN-20261022-018 failed 17 of 242 (view-switch options 40 px tall; two scrollable regions without keyboard focus) and is preserved; after the fixes RUN-20261022-019 passes 242/242 with gates.

Visual review at 1440 x 900, 1180 x 820 and 820 x 1180 found deck lines broken in the narrow region, chip-in-button ink filters, a duplicated save status (two status regions), the inspector rendered outside the layout and a quest set shown instead of the printed set; all were fixed before the passing receipt. Captures are in the ignored .local/ux-01-review/.
Design-system runbook (deckbuilder composition) and the UX-01 build section of the design-system validation.
